snippet.title: Legacy Launch Trailer | Halo Infinite
snippet.description:
Turn back the clock with the Delta Arena: Halo 3 Legacy Playlist, featuring classic maps, retro-inspired gameplay, and a flood of nostalgia. Get your hands on the HAYABUSA ZOKUHEN bundle in The Exchange and enjoy the new era of Grifball with new modes and third-person variants. 

Upgrade to the Premium Operation Pass for 20 tiers of rewards, including the EOD GEN1 helmet, bonus XP, an extra challenge slot, and instant unlocks. 

Operation: Legacy ends July 8. 

Read more on our blog: https://aka.ms/LegacyLaunch
